messages:
sasha: Heads-up — security wants to shorten SIEM export TTL for external partner extracts from 30d -> 7d. This impacts RBAC and the KMS unwrap flow. Any blockers on our side?
raj: What's driving 7d? Is that from legal/compliance or ops?
emily: From incident triage POV shorter TTL is fine but we need a clean handoff so analysts can still get time-bound snapshots during investigations. How will they request?
security-engineer: Compliance asked for 7d as a risk reduction for third-party exports. We propose: (1) enforce a per-export TTL, (2) require a ticket id + approver for any export, (3) gate KMS unwrap with a scoped token tied to the ticket.
raj: Sounds reasonable. We should ensure platform alerting when an analyst attempts to extend TTL. Also need to distinguish internal vs external exports in RBAC (internal longer TTL allowed).
sasha: Agreed. Proposal sketch: create a temporary role siem_export_requester with attributes: {max_ttl: "7d", requires_approval: true, allowed_destinations: ["partner-a","s3-partners"]}. Internal role siem_ops retains 30d.
security-engineer: Example policy snippet we tested in dev: 
```json
{
  "role": "siem_export_requester",
  "max_ttl": "7d",
  "requires": ["ticket_id","approver_email"],
  "actions": ["export:create","export:read"]
}
```
emily: Good. What about the KMS side? We can't give analysts direct key unwrap. Need proxy service that mints ephemeral unwrap tokens per-ticket.
security-engineer: Exactly — plan: kms-proxy validates ticket + approver, calls KMS to generate a one-time unwrap-token, returns that token to the export service which uses it for a single unwrap. Tokens auto-expire in 10m. Audit event logged: kms_proxy.unwrap (ticket_id, exporter, requester).
raj: Can we reuse existing kms-proxy flow used by forensics snapshots? If yes, devs just flip a flag.
sasha: We can reuse it but need a minor change: add destination scoping so tokens only unwrap ciphertext labelled for partner exports.
oncall-bot: Approval recorded: oncall raj approved export policy change under ticket SEC-512 at 16:02 UTC :white_check_mark:
emily: Operational checklist for rollout: 1) create roles/policies in prod IAM 2) enable TTL enforcement in exporter service 3) update kms-proxy to scope tokens 4) add alerting for export extension attempts 5) update runbook (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/siem-exports)
sasha: I'll open a brief RFC and a PR with policy JSON + small kms-proxy change. Target rollout to staging tomorrow, prod mid-week pending no issues. Any objections?
raj: No objections from me. Thanks.
security-engineer: No objections. I'll add the audit event schema to the PR.
sasha: Thanks all — will ping when PR is up.
